reviews.t: Be careful which style you buy.
reviews.x: These are rhose weak, bendable ones...not the strong straight ones that don’t bend.  They carry those and they’re great!  Look at pucs closely and read descriptions.  Hard to tell apart as packaging is same.
SO much better than the ones that came with the brush rollers.  Longer and don't have "knobs" halfway down like the others and they keep the rollers much more secure and much more comfortable.

reviews.t: Will do the job but not the best
reviews.x: They are not as strong as metal ones, so do not hold the rollers in place as tightly

reviews.t: HOLDS IN ROLLERS WITHOUT SNAGGING MY HAIR!
reviews.x: My hair was getting fried from using curling irons, so I went back to the "old fashioned" mesh rollers (without brushes).  I was using long clips to hold in the rollers....OUCH! My hair was getting tangled in them and being pulled out when I removed them.  I went online, hoping "they still made them" (I'm a flower child of the 60's)...and was thrilled to purchase them.  Then I feared they wouldn't work because the rollers have no brushes, but I put two in each roller, so they criss-cross in the

Absolutely unacceptable.  I just received the roller picks and some of them were falling out of the box.  Upon closer inspection it’s apparent that the box was opened and then taped shut.  Apparently they thought it was acceptable to sell something to me that has already been opened. To make matters worse, the have a no return policy.  Ridiculous.

These are better than Bobby pins or clips!  All you do is roll your hair in the curler and push the pin at the base of the curler next to your scalp and you're done!  I have very long, thick hair and one pin will do the job but I use two because they're so easy to put in and take out. Great for traveling to!  There's no going back to the old way for me!

Great picks for hair rollers! Smooth, they don’t damage your hair when inserting. Length is perfect, I use large 1 1/2 inch & medium rollers. Happy to find these with no nobbies on sides. Nobbies on sides of picks to help hold in place damage tear my hair.
I never got the picks....nothing...not even a credit ...I'm sure they know I didn't get the products ...so it didn't cost much ... that's not the point. Crumbs !!!!

If you like to give your hair a good old fashion roller set from time to time these hair picks are awesome!  They're long enough to fit through large rollers (which I own).  They kept my rollers secure,( I did have a few to loosen as my hair dried, but I expected for that to happen). The price is reasonable.  I love the product. I bought only one pack because I wasn't sure if I was going to like them, but I'll be purchasing more in the future.

These are hard to find in the local stores as not many people use hair rollers anymore. My neighbor who is an experienced knitter had asked me to find some for her. She uses them to "pin" together the knitted pieces for seaming. They are perfect for that so I bought a pack for her and one for me. The price was low and they arrived quickly

[[VIDEOID:5160651ae99bcf50ffaa52999335f8e4]] My hair is longer than half way down my back. I needed something to hold my hair rollers into place. I use jumbo and large hair rollers. These picks help to hold my hair rollers in place, while I'm under the hair dryer. These picks help me to achieve the hair style that I want at home.

I bought these pins to use with my regular plastic rollers that came with a half cylinder cover to hold them.  the cylinder covers make lined marks on my hair so I don't like to use them but these pins work Ok.  I wish they had longer ones for my big rollers.

If the rollers I had were any good these would probably work but with mesh rollers (with no brush inside) the picks cannot hold the roller in place. I used two picks per roller and they just fell out.
I am using this for cards I am making and these picks are miniature knitting needles.  Not what this product would normally be used for, but that's why i bought them.

reviews.t: Pic is Long, smooth, effortlessly glides through roller.

claims.text: Many reviewers find these picks hold rollers securely and are comfortable, long enough for large rollers, and better than clips or bobby pins.
Some reviewers find the picks weak or bendable and say they don't hold rollers as tightly as metal ones, especially with mesh rollers.
Reviewers appreciate that these picks lack side knobs/nobbies, which they say prevents snagging and hair damage.
Several reviewers use these picks for non-hair purposes such as knitting, seaming, and card-making.
A few reviewers report order problems, including an opened package and a lost order with no credit.
